{{Quote|Don't remind me. I saw a squad of Espos cut loose on a bunch of laborers during a "contract dispute." When used properly, these things are flargin' deadly.|[[Durund]]|<ref name="GFT" />}}
The '''Espo grenade mortar''' was a mobile [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] [[grenade mortar]], with an integrated [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] unit. The repulsorlift did not propel the mortar, but did allow an operator to push or pull the mortar into position.<ref name="GFT" /> The mortar was capable of firing any type of [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] up to a distance of a [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]], and had an ammunition capacity of a hundred grenades.<ref name="ROE" />

The [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] armed their [[Security Police/Legends|Security Police]] with the mortar. A [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of Espos deployed them against laborers involved in a contract dispute.<ref name="GFT" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a shipment of the mortars were captured during a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] raid, and soon became a favorite of [[Heavy Weapons Specialists]] serving in [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]].<ref name="ROE" />
